text: A black ribbed dresser with gold handles and legs sits against a light gray wall, topped with white ceramic vases, a white bowl, and a white table lamp with a cone shade. A round black-framed mirror hangs above. To the right, a cream upholstered armchair with nailhead trim holds a light pillow and white throw blanket. The camera orbits smoothly from a front-facing view upward and to the right, gradually revealing a top-down perspective of the furniture arrangement.
